name: Aurora Bench (official showcase)
author: vBookmarks

tokens.--vbm-glow-hover: 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in srgb, #7ee8fa 36%, transparent), 0 0 14px color-mix(in srgb, #7ee8fa 20%, transparent)
tokens.--vbm-glow-focus: 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in srgb, #7ee8fa 46%, transparent), 0 0 16px color-mix(in srgb, #7ee8fa 28%, transparent)
tokens.--vbm-glow-selected: 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in srgb, #b14aed 52%, transparent), 0 0 19px color-mix(in srgb, #b14aed 34%, transparent)
tokens.--vbm-canvas-image: url(data:image/svg+xml;base64,), repeating-conic-gradient(color-mix(in srgb, #7ee8fa 2.5%, transparent) 0% 25%, transparent 0% 50%), repeating-conic-gradient(color-mix(in srgb, #b14aed 2%, transparent) 0% 25%, transparent 0% 50%)
